user.title: Set up Chores & Maintenance
user.description: This creates the hub. Add chores and set up notifications afterward from the hub's Configure button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one Chores & Maintenance hub is allowed.

data.name: Name
data.interval_days: Repeat every this many days (only used when repeating by days)
data.cycle_threshold: Repeat every this many uses (only used when repeating by uses)
data.nfc_enabled: Mark done by scanning an NFC tag
data.nfc_tag_entity_id: Which NFC tag (only used if the option above is on)
data.notification_enabled: Mark done from a button in the reminder notification
data.notify_time: What time to send the reminder (only used if the option above is on)
data.weekends_only: Only send reminders on weekends (only used if reminders are enabled above)
data.message: What the reminder should say — leave blank to just say the chore's name is due

abort.no_chores: There are no chores to remove yet.
